senses.gloss:
वगला वगला or वगला-मुखी, f. a god-
dess worshipped by the Tāntrikas.

वगाह व-गाह, अस्, m. (for अव-गाह),
bathing, ablution.

व-गाह्य, ind. having bathed, bathing, dipping
into; having entered.
वग्नु वग्नु, वग्वनु. See p. 878, col. 1.

वग्वन, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. (perhaps) talkative,
chattering; praising.

वग्वनु, उस्, m., Ved. a sound, noise, (Sāy. =
शब्द.)

वागुजी वागुजी, f. the plant Serratula An-
thelmintica (= सोम-राजी).

वागुण वागुण, अस्, m. the plant Averrhoa
Carambola (= कर्मरङ्ग).

वागुरा वागुरा, f. (fr. rt. 2. वा?), a net (for
catching deer or wild animals), trap, toils, snare,
noose.
—वागुरा-वृत्ति, इस्, f. livelihood obtained
by snaring or catching wild animals; (इस्), m. one
who lives by snaring animals.

वागुरिक, अस्, m. one who uses nets for catching
deer, &c., a deer-catcher, hunter.
वागुस वागुस, अस्, m. a sort of large fish.

वागर, अस्, m. a sage, holy man, one desirous of
final emancipation; a scholar, Paṇḍit, learned Brāh-
man; a hero, brave man, intrepid or fearless person;
certainty, ascertainment; a whetstone; an obstacle,
impediment, obstruction; submarine fire; a wolf.

वागारु, उस्, उस्, उ (said to be fr. वाच्, compounded
with आरु fr. rt. 4. ऋ, q. v.), breaking promise or
faith, disappointing, a disappointer, deceiver.

वाग्मिन्, ई, इनी, इ, speaking much, loquacious, talka-
tive, verbose, wordy; speaking well, eloquent; (ई), m.,
N. of Vṛhas-pati (preceptor of the gods).
—वाग्मि-
ता, f. or वाग्मि-त्व, अम्, n. loquacity, eloquence.

वाग्य, अस्, आ, अम्, speaking little, speaking cau-
tiously or humbly (perhaps fr. वाच् + य fr. rt. यम्;
cf. वाग्-यत); speaking truly; (अस्), m. modesty,
humility, self-disparagement; doubt, alternative (?).
—वाग्य-तस्, ind. silently.
